counter.note: Keep this exact page_id: it is the counter the profile has always used, so changing provider or id restarts the count from zero (it happened once, 373 -> 1, when komarev replaced it). right_color #0969DA (Primer accent) carries white digits at 5.1:1 and reads on both themes. Every GET increments it, so verify.py budgets it at a fixed 1,310 B instead of fetching it.

design._source: Surfaces are GitHub Primer tokens, verbatim, so the SVG background equals the page background and the rounded corners disappear - the panel reads as page furniture instead of a boxed image. Tokens read from primer/primitives: src/tokens/base/color/{dark,light}/*.json5 and src/tokens/functional/color/{bgColor,fgColor,borderColor}.json5. Accents are blue only, so the panel sits with GitHub and the Arch logo: arch is Arch Linux blue (#1793D1, the official logo colour; #0969DA on light, which is Primer accent), sky and cyan are GitHub's own ANSI/syntax blues (dark #79C0FF / #39C5CF, light #0550AE / #1B7C83).
design.font: IBM Plex Mono (OFL), subset to outlines at build time
